name: CLIProxyAPI Quota
description: Remaining subscription quota of every Claude, Codex and Antigravity account behind your CLIProxyAPI server: percent used and reset time per window, in a sidebar panel and the status bar.

settings.title: CLIProxyAPI URL
settings.description: Base URL of the CLIProxyAPI server, without /v1 or /v8/management. https:// for remote servers (plain http:// only for localhost); remote servers also need management.allow-remote: true. The management key is sent only to the server it was saved for.

settings.title: Poll interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the quota of every account is read, through CLIProxyAPI. Each read sends one quota request per enabled account; Antigravity accounts may try up to three hosts, and Claude accounts also ask for their plan until it is known. An account rests for 15 minutes after its provider answers 429, and for 30 minutes after it refuses the account (401 or 403). A poll starts no new read after its interval (but never before 4 minutes, and at most 5); accounts it did not get to are read first in the next poll.
